description: Defines each selectable Arcade root: an ordered mission-ID list for each difficulty and the localization key for its displayed title. Unlock conditions and run progress are stored elsewhere (CharacterArcadeDataTable and the Arcade run state).

Id.technical: FName (default NAME_None) declared as the row's import key/ID. Exported rows key their ID field to the row name (ARCADE_MISSION_A..F). Lookup keys are supplied by FGameDataTableRow_CharacterArcade::Id_ArcadeMissionSet[RootIndex] when building the root list and later by Game->ArcadeRun.RootSelection.RootId; BattleArcade_GetMissionIds and the overview walk ArcadeMissionSetDataTables (DTM+0x970) with UDataTable::FindRow, so the first loaded table containing that key wins (the manager registers only ArcadeMissionSetDataTable). The member is also read as a value: the list-item widget copies MissionSet->Id into DecidedRootId on Decide and FocusedRootId on focus; MenuSequence copies DecidedRootId to RootSelection.RootId and then to the GameManager run.

Id_ArcadeMission_Easy.simple: Ordered mission ids used for the Easy difficulty and as the fallback list.
Id_ArcadeMission_Easy.technical: TArray<FName> (default empty). BattleArcade_GetMissionIds first empties its output and returns this array when Difficulty is not exactly Normal (2) or Hard (3): Easy (1), None (0), Invalid (255) and any other byte all take this branch. A missing mission-set row also returns an empty array. The list is copied in order without filtering None; root-info panels use the array index as the stage index (panel 0 gets stage 0 and its detail number is Index+1), while BattleArcade_IsLastMission treats a missing or None id at Index+1 as the end of the run. All exported Easy/Normal/Hard lists have five IDs and all 90 references resolve to ArcadeMissionDataTable rows.

Id_ArcadeMission_Normal.simple: Ordered mission ids used for the Normal difficulty.
Id_ArcadeMission_Normal.technical: TArray<FName> (default empty). BattleArcade_GetMissionIds copies this array only when the difficulty byte equals EGameArcadeDifficulty::Normal (2); otherwise it selects Hard (3) or the Easy fallback. The UI starts on Normal (OnOpenBegin) and cycles Easy/Normal/Hard before calling UpdateRootInfo. During a run, IntervalArcade chooses the current mission with MissionIds[BattleResults.Num()], so list order and the won-battle count define the stage on that path; that index is not explicitly bounds-checked.

Id_ArcadeMission_Hard.simple: Ordered mission ids used for the Hard difficulty.
Id_ArcadeMission_Hard.technical: TArray<FName> (default empty). BattleArcade_GetMissionIds copies this array only when the difficulty byte equals EGameArcadeDifficulty::Hard (3). The helper does not validate the IDs; root-info and overview consumers skip a mission whose ArcadeMissionDataTable lookup fails, while IntervalArcade resolves the current mission without a null/bounds check. Every exported Hard slot is populated and resolves to a mission row; None, when encountered as the next ID, is treated as the end of the run by BattleArcade_IsLastMission.

Id_Text_Title.simple: Localization text id for the root's displayed title.
Id_Text_Title.technical: FName (default None). UGameArcadeRootSelectListItemWidget::SetItemData passes it directly to RootNameText->SetTextIdOnly. SetTextIdOnly creates an id-only text request: None clears the text, while a SYS_ id is resolved by AGameTextManager through SystemTextDataTable's language columns. The six exported values are SYS_ARCADE_ROOT_SELECT_ROOT_LABEL_0001..0006; those keys exist in SystemTextDataTable (English 'Route A'..'Route F'). This table stores only the key, not the localized string.

notes: The supplied export has one AssetVariant, one row struct (GameDataTableRow_ArcadeMissionSet, ImportKeyField=Id) and six rows (ARCADE_MISSION_A..F). Each row has three five-entry mission-ID arrays and one title text id. Cross-checked references: all 90 mission IDs resolve to ArcadeMissionDataTable rows and all six title keys resolve to SystemTextDataTable rows.

GameDataTableManager registers ArcadeMissionSetDataTable by name, resolves its loader after all table loads complete, and adds the loaded UDataTable to ArcadeMissionSetDataTables (DTM+0x970). The configured array contains that one asset; no numbered shards or localization variants of this table exist in the supplied exports. Every finder walks the array and uses the first row hit.

Root discovery is external: FGameDataTableRow_CharacterArcade::Id_ArcadeMissionSet supplies the candidate SetId at its array Index. The exported CharacterArcadeDataTable has 27 character rows and all 27 per-character shards list ARCADE_MISSION_A..F in the same order. That Index also indexes CharacterArcade::ClearFlagConditions and the user clear bits on the root-select screen; unlock/clear state is not stored in this table.

EGameArcadeDifficulty is a uint8 enum: None=0, Easy=1, Normal=2, Hard=3, Invalid=255. The root-select UI starts at Normal and cycles Easy/Normal/Hard; MenuSequence copies the widget Difficulty byte into Run.RootSelection.RootByte, and FGameArcadeSettings::Reset writes 255. BattleArcade_GetMissionIds special-cases only 2 and 3, so every other byte uses the Easy list.

Order is significant. Root info builds up to five mission panels and numbers details from Index+1; the situation overview marks Index < BattleResults.Num() as won and Index == BattleResults.Num() as current; BattleArcade_IsLastMission checks the next slot and treats a missing slot or NAME_None as the end. IntervalArcade indexes MissionIds[BattleResults.Num()] without an explicit bounds check. The export contains no None entries in the three lists.

Evidence provenance: status/functions.json labels 0x12fc180 (BattleArcade_GetMissionIds), 0x14c16d0 (root-select Setup), 0x14c8730 (root-info UpdateRootInfo) and 0x165afe0 (overview SetupArcade) behavioural/BEHAV-certified, while 0x14d41b0 (list-item SetItemData), 0x14c57a0 (Decide), 0x14b9cc0 (focus), 0x1311060 (IsLastMission) and 0x14ad760 (StepDifficulty) are INV MATCH. Behavioural means reconstructed behaviour, not byte parity.

No retail Blueprint graph, editor asset, cooked runtime or live game run was inspected for this table. Blueprint/editor-only consumers cannot be exhaustively excluded from the partial supplied Content; the runtime statements above are traced reconstructed C++ (with the recorded status just described) plus the supplied exports.

usages.detail: Loads ArcadeMissionSetDataTable into ArcadeMissionSetDataTables (DTM+0x970) after all table loaders complete.
Resolves CharacterArcade::Id_ArcadeMissionSet[Index] to a mission-set row and caches the pointer in ListItemDataArray[].MissionSet.
Displays the cached row's Id_Text_Title through RootNameText->SetTextIdOnly.
Copies the cached row's Id into DecidedRootId; OnWidgetFocused copies it into FocusedRootId.
BattleArcade_GetMissionIds selects one of the three arrays by difficulty and returns it in order for the mission preview panels.
Copies DecidedRootId and the widget Difficulty byte into the menu sequence, then into Game->ArcadeRun.RootSelection.
Uses Run.RootSelection.RootId/RootByte to obtain mission IDs for overview progression; the separate mission-set lookup is discarded.
Uses the difficulty-specific list and BattleResults.Num() to set ArcadeRun.MissionId for the next battle.
BattleArcade_IsLastMission calls the same helper and treats a missing or None next ID as the end of the run.
Uses IsLastMission with the stored RootId/RootByte to decide clear recording and victory-sequence behavior.
Resolves the title text id through GameTextManager, which routes SYS_ ids to SystemTextDataTable language columns.
